description: Asynchronous JSON-array bulk dataset import. Adds the versioned bulk request/response contracts, the RawDatasetImport operation table + Alembic migration, the shared Raw service helpers (resolve_bulk_sources / apply_bulk_dataset_import / stale_raw_consumers) with the single-dataset routes refactored onto them, the three async endpoints (create 202 + Idempotency-Key + Location, status GET, cancel), the durable worker handler with job-vs-business-failure semantics and cancellation, plus docs + regenerated frontend typed client. Depends on FEAT-001 (the import references already-uploaded source_file_ids and shares config.py edits). Design: §3.3-§3.6, §4.2-§4.3, §5.2-§5.5, §6, §7, §8, §9-§11, AC2-AC8.
steps: SETTINGS: add raw_bulk_import_max_entries: int = 500 and raw_bulk_import_max_total_bytes: int = 2_147_483_648 to Settings in src/app/config.py (near the FEAT-001 setting). Expose a module constant RAW_BULK_IMPORT_MAX_ENTRIES mirroring the default for use in the request contract field constraint.

CONTRACTS: in src/app/raw/contracts.py add RawDatasetImportEntry(StrictModel) (code: Field(pattern=r'^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,63}$'); label 1..255; description optional <=4000; source_file_id: UUID; initialize_variables: bool = False) and RawDatasetImportRequest(StrictModel) (schema_version: Literal['1.0.0']='1.0.0'; expected_raw_revision: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=1); entries: tuple[RawDatasetImportEntry, ...] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=RAW_BULK_IMPORT_MAX_ENTRIES) with a model_validator(mode='after') raising on intra-batch duplicate codes so FastAPI returns 422). Add ImportStatus = Literal['queued','running','succeeded','failed','cancelled'] and RawDatasetImportResponse (model_config from_attributes=True; id, raw_id, study_id, status: ImportStatus, schema_version: str, entry_count: int, files_inspected: int, input_fingerprint: str, result_dataset_ids: list[UUID], issues: list[ValidationIssue] validated from stored JSONB dicts via a field_validator, failure: dict|None, started_at/completed_at: datetime|None, created_by: str, created_at: datetime). Put the response model wherever imports stay clean (contracts.py or routes.py).

MODEL: add RawDatasetImport to src/app/raw/models.py modeled on ArtifactBuild: UuidPrimaryKey; raw_id FK raw_workbenches.id ondelete=RESTRICT index; study_id FK studies.id ondelete=RESTRICT index; schema_version String(16) not null; status String(32) not null default 'queued'; entries JSONB not null; input_fingerprint String(64) not null; entry_count Integer not null; files_inspected Integer not null default 0; result_dataset_ids JSONB not null default list; issues JSONB not null default list; failure JSONB nullable; started_at/completed_at DateTime(timezone=True) nullable; created_by String(255) not null; created_at DateTime(tz) not null default utc_now. It is an OPERATION ROW; do NOT add it to descriptor.entity_types and do NOT add a resolve_entity branch.

MIGRATION: add migrations/versions/<new>_raw_dataset_imports.py with down_revision = '20261009_0012' (current head). upgrade() creates raw_dataset_imports plus indexes ix_raw_dataset_imports_raw_id and ix_raw_dataset_imports_study_id, with explicit fk_.../ix_... constraint names, RESTRICT FKs, ORM-side JSONB defaults only (no server_default, matching artifact_builds), status as plain String(32). downgrade() drops the indexes then the table. Keep a single Alembic head.

SERVICE HELPERS: in src/app/raw/service.py add a frozen ResolvedSource value object (id, artifact_id, object_key, sha256, filename, study_id, size) and three module-level functions. stale_raw_consumers(session, registry, raw) relocates the exact logic of routes._stale (artifacts.mark_owner_stale for raw_workbench; mark succeeded Raw ValidationRuns stale; registry.require_handler('sdtm', ModuleCapability.STALENESS).mark_raw_refresh fan-out marking sdtm_workbench artifacts stale). resolve_bulk_sources(session, *, study_id, entries) -> tuple[list[ResolvedSource | None], list[ValidationIssue]] resolves each entry's SourceFile within the study, returning a list POSITIONALLY ALIGNED to entries (None where a raw_source_file_invalid issue is recorded) plus the accumulated issue list; it NEVER raises for a missing/foreign source. apply_bulk_dataset_import(session, registry, *, raw, entries, resolved_sources, snapshots, created_by) -> list[RawDataset] asserts len(entries)==len(resolved_sources)==len(snapshots) and no None, then per index creates RawDataset -> binding_for(resolved_sources[i]) -> optional variable init from snapshots[i] (reuse the initialize_variables fill logic: create missing variables / fill missing physical_type,length,precision), then after all entries a SINGLE raw.revision bump and stale_raw_consumers; caller commits once; returns datasets in entry order.

REFACTOR ROUTES: refactor src/app/raw/routes.py create_dataset, patch_dataset, retire_dataset, create_variable, patch_variable, delete_variable, initialize_variables, patch_raw to call stale_raw_consumers instead of the local _stale. Keep a thin _source wrapper in routes.py that uses resolve_bulk_sources for a single id and raises ProblemException(422, 'raw_source_file_invalid', ...) when it reports a missing source, preserving current single-dataset HTTP behavior. Remove the now-duplicated _stale body (or make it delegate). The worker must import only service.py, never routes.py.

ENDPOINTS: in src/app/raw/routes.py add POST /raw/{raw_id}/datasets/import (thin handler): _raw(session, registry, raw_id, principal); require Idempotency-Key else ProblemException 400 idempotency_key_required; input_fingerprint = fingerprint(command.model_dump(mode='json')); idempotency replay/reuse against IdempotencyRecord filtered by subject=principal.subject, route='raw-dataset-import', study_id=raw.study_id, key=idempotency_key (no record -> create RawDatasetImport(schema_version, entries=[e.model_dump(mode='json') for e in command.entries], entry_count, input_fingerprint, raw_id, study_id, created_by) + Job(operation_id=import.id, job_type='raw_dataset_import', payload={'import_id': str(import.id)}, max_attempts=settings.job_max_attempts) + IdempotencyRecord(resource_type='raw_dataset_import', resource_id=import.id, request_fingerprint=input_fingerprint) in one commit, set Location: /api/v1/raw-dataset-imports/{import.id}, return 202 RawDatasetImportResponse status 'queued'; same request_fingerprint -> bare return RawDatasetImportResponse.model_validate(prior) under the 202 decorator with NO response.status_code override and NO new Location; different request_fingerprint -> ProblemException 409 idempotency_key_reused). Settings come from request.app.state.settings. Add GET /raw-dataset-imports/{import_id} and POST /raw-dataset-imports/{import_id}/cancel: each resolves the RawDatasetImport row (404 raw_dataset_import_not_found) and StudyService.require_access(session, import.study_id, principal). Cancel mirrors cancel_artifact_build: if status not in {queued,running} -> 409 invalid_lifecycle_transition; else status='cancelled', completed_at=utc_now(), set the Job's cancellation_requested_at (lookup Job by operation_id == import.id), commit, return the response.

WORKER: in workers/job_worker.py add _handle_raw_dataset_import(factory, registry, storage, job_id) following the T1 / untransacted-middle / T2 skeleton of _handle_artifact_build with the design's §3.5 rule. T1 (short txn): load Job + RawDatasetImport; TERMINAL-STATE GUARD: if import.status in {succeeded,failed,cancelled} -> JobService().complete(job); return. If job.cancellation_requested_at is not None or import.status=='cancelled' -> set cancelled + completed_at + complete(job); return. Else set status='running', started_at; call resolve_bulk_sources(session, study_id=import.study_id, entries=<rehydrated RawDatasetImportEntry list>) collecting issues + aligned list[ResolvedSource|None]; capture raw.revision; commit/close (no object I/O). MIDDLE (no txn): if summed size of resolved files > settings.raw_bulk_import_max_total_bytes -> record raw_bulk_import_too_large issue (fail path). Iterating entry order, inspect each DISTINCT source_file_id ONCE (cache by source_file_id): open storage.open(object_key) one at a time, verify SHA-256 against stored sha256 (raw_source_checksum_mismatch on mismatch), call inspect_file(stream, filename) forwarding error.code/error.detail verbatim as issues (raw_file_format_unsupported / raw_physical_schema_invalid / raw_json_shape_invalid), close each stream before opening the next; build list[RawPhysicalSnapshot|None] aligned to entries (None at positions that already failed). Retain only snapshots + issues, never raw rows. T2 (short txn): re-apply terminal-state + cancellation guards; if expected_raw_revision pinned and raw.revision != pinned -> failed + stale_raw_revision + complete(job); if any issue collected (any None) -> status='failed', issues=[i.model_dump(mode='json') ...], complete(job), write NO datasets; else call apply_bulk_dataset_import, set result_dataset_ids, files_inspected=count of distinct files inspected, status='succeeded', complete(job). Wrap the apply in try/except IntegrityError: on a late duplicate, rollback and in a fresh factory.begin() set status='failed' + duplicate_raw_dataset_code + complete(job). Every business outcome uses complete(); only transient infra (object store down, deadlock, unexpected exception) propagates to _process_job's except boundary / uses fail().

WORKER REGISTRATION: register 'raw_dataset_import' in (a) main()'s JobService.claim(..., job_types=(...)) tuple, (b) _process_job's dispatch (call _handle_raw_dataset_import), and (c) a new _record_failure branch that marks the RawDatasetImport failed + failure + completed_at ONLY when job.status == 'failed' (attempts exhausted), mirroring the artifact_build branch.

TYPED-CLIENT FIXTURE: add the three new paths to tests/contract/typed_client_fixture.py::PHASE3_RAW_SDTM_OPERATIONS: '/api/v1/raw/{raw_id}/datasets/import': {'post'}, '/api/v1/raw-dataset-imports/{import_id}': {'get'}, '/api/v1/raw-dataset-imports/{import_id}/cancel': {'post'}. Keep tests/contract/test_phase3.py::test_phase3_typed_client_fixture_matches_openapi green.

TESTS - unit (tests/unit): RawDatasetImportRequest validation (empty array -> error, over-limit, intra-batch duplicate code -> 422, bad code pattern, extra field rejected); fingerprint(command.model_dump(mode='json')) stability; resolve_bulk_sources happy path and each per-entry issue branch with a fake session; apply_bulk_dataset_import happy path incl. 'two entries sharing one source_file_id -> two datasets, two bindings, one inspection'; worker job-vs-business rule (a content rejection calls JobService.complete, not fail); terminal-state guard makes a redelivered terminal run a no-op; cancel handler transitions a queued import to cancelled.

TESTS - property (tests/unit, Hypothesis): a batch of unique codes yields exactly one dataset per entry and exactly one revision bump; any batch containing a duplicate/invalid entry yields zero datasets (all-or-nothing).

TESTS - repository integration (tests/integration, AURINARA_INTEGRATION=1, reuse Phase 3 client + _process_job): migration applies up/down from an empty DB; a committed import is a single transaction (row counts before/after); late IntegrityError path rolls back fully and the Job ends succeeded with a failed run; idempotency replay returns the same run and reuse returns 409; a deterministic content failure keeps attempt_count == 1 (not requeued); claim of the new job type via FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED. Storage integration: worker inspection releases each file stream before opening the next (storage spy fails if two streams open at once).

DOCS + FRONTEND CLIENT: update docs/api-contract.md (two Raw endpoints + the raw-dataset-imports status resource in the route inventory and the async-operation/Location table; note :bulk under bulk uploads) and docs/artifact-catalog.md (one sentence: bulk import creates the same raw_dataset/binding records and provenance as single create; no new artifact type). Regenerate the frontend typed client: in frontend/ run `npm run api:sync` then `npm run typecheck`; commit the regenerated frontend/openapi.json and frontend/src/api/generated/** (raw + artifacts operations).
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/v1/raw/{raw_id}/datasets/import with a JSON array and an Idempotency-Key returns 202, a Location: /api/v1/raw-dataset-imports/{import_id}, and a response with status 'queued'. Omitting the key -> 400 idempotency_key_required; same key+body -> prior run at 202; same key, different body -> 409 idempotency_key_reused.
GET /api/v1/raw-dataset-imports/{import_id} returns current status; on success lists created raw_dataset IDs; on failure returns the full typed ValidationIssue list and created no datasets.

A batch with a duplicate code (intra-batch or against the workbench) or an unresolvable/foreign-study source_file_id terminates the run 'failed' with a per-entry issue, writes no raw_datasets/raw_dataset_file_bindings rows, and the backing Job is 'succeeded' with attempt_count == 1 (never requeued).

On success the workbench revision bumps exactly once, Raw validation + Raw/SDTM artifacts stale exactly as a single-dataset create, and each new dataset has an immutable raw_dataset_file_bindings row.

The worker streams/inspects files and initializes variables outside any open DB transaction (no transaction held across object-store I/O). Cancelling a queued import -> cancelled synchronously; cancelling a running import is observed at the next transaction boundary; neither writes datasets.

The new Alembic migration applies up/down from an empty database and is reversible; a single Alembic head remains; raw_dataset_import is NOT registered as an owned entity type and descriptor startup validation still passes.

ruff check ., ruff format --check ., and mypy src workers succeed; pytest tests/unit tests/contract passes; with AURINARA_INTEGRATION=1 pytest tests/integration passes; frontend npm run typecheck passes against the regenerated client.
verification: cd into the worktree; ruff check . ; ruff format --check . ; mypy src workers
migration from empty DB against a fresh clinical_test: uv run alembic upgrade head ; uv run alembic downgrade -1 ; uv run alembic upgrade head ; uv run alembic heads (single head)
cd frontend ; npm run api:sync ; npm run typecheck
findings:
IMPLEMENTED & VERIFIED. Backend: ruff check/format clean; mypy src workers clean; pytest tests/unit tests/contract = 239 passed; AURINARA_INTEGRATION=1 pytest tests/integration = 30 passed / 5 runner-skipped (includes 7 new bulk-import tests + migration round-trip). Migration up/down/up verified against a fresh clinical_test (single head 20261010_0013). Frontend: npm run api:sync regenerated frontend/openapi.json (177 paths) + src/api/generated/** (new createDatasetImport/getDatasetImport/cancelDatasetImport in raw.ts, RawDatasetImportRequest/Response models, split ValidationIssue model files); npm run typecheck passes.

KEY DECISIONS / NOTES:
(1) expected_raw_revision pin: the RawDatasetImport MODEL step lists no column for it and the ENDPOINTS step does not persist it, but the WORKER step requires the T2 stale_raw_revision check. To honor both without a model/migration change, the create handler passes the pin on the Job.payload ({'import_id':..., 'expected_raw_revision': N}) only when non-null; the worker reads job.payload['expected_raw_revision'] in T1 and compares in T2 (issue code stale_raw_revision). The pin is still part of input_fingerprint (fingerprint over the whole command.model_dump), so idempotency replay/reuse behave as designed.
(2) RAW_BULK_IMPORT_MAX_ENTRIES constant lives in src/app/raw/contracts.py (next to the request contract field constraint) to avoid a config->contracts import; it mirrors Settings.raw_bulk_import_max_entries (500). The settings layer remains the runtime source.
(3) routes._stale was reduced to a one-line delegate to service.stale_raw_consumers (all 8 single-dataset call sites unchanged); routes._source now resolves via service.resolve_bulk_sources and raises 422 raw_source_file_invalid, preserving single-create HTTP behavior. The dead RawConsumerStaleness Protocol and unused Protocol import were removed from routes.py.
(4) apply_bulk_dataset_import validates all positions non-None BEFORE creating any row (true all-or-nothing at the function level), in addition to the DB-transaction rollback; the worker only calls it when the issue list is empty.
(5) _process_job gained an optional trailing settings param (defaults to get_settings()) so the ~20 existing _process_job(factory, registry, storage, job) call sites in the integration suites keep working unchanged; main() now claims 'raw_dataset_import' and passes settings positionally last.
(6) ISSUE_NAMESPACE is now exported from src/app/raw/service.py and reused by both the service bulk-issue builder and the worker _import_issue builder so bulk issue IDs match Raw's single-path uuid5 identity scheme.
(7) raw_dataset_import is an OPERATION ROW: NOT added to descriptor.entity_types and no resolve_entity branch; descriptor startup validation still passes.
(8) FEAT-001 had not added the :bulk source-file endpoint to docs/api-contract.md; this change adds it plus the two Raw endpoints, the raw-dataset-imports status resource, the async-operation/Location table row, and the Idempotency-Key sentence, and adds the one-sentence artifact-catalog note (no new artifact type).

LIMITATIONS: (a) The 'cancelling a RUNNING import' path (worker observes cancellation at the next transaction boundary) is covered structurally by the T1/T2 guards and the queued-cancel integration test, but there is no concurrent running-cancel race test (single-threaded _process_job driver). (b) tests/e2e scenario for the full upload->import->poll->stale flow was not added here (deferred to the Release-1 e2e matrix). (c) The pre-existing tests/unit/test_adam_specification_workbook.py::test_workbook_round_trip_is_lossless_and_deterministic is timing-flaky (ZIP local-header mod-time crosses a 2s boundary); it is unrelated to FEAT-002 and passes in isolation.
